name: Guangdong Prov Aca
summary: Guangdong Provincial Academy of Building Research Group Co., Ltd. provides inspection and testing technical services in the construction engineering field in China. It offers its services to building construction and municipal engineering, transportation, water conservancy, energy conservation and environmental protection, work safety, and metrology sectors. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Architectural Scientific Research Institute and changed its name to Guangdong Provincial Academy of Building Research Group Co., Ltd. in December 2014. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Guangzhou, China. Guangdong Provincial Academy of Building Research Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Guangdong Construction Engineering Group Co.,Ltd.
